programmes.evidence: Official current School of Applied Management PhD research-area page explicitly invites applications in Operations Management as one of four listed subject areas and explains applicants select a subject area in the research-degree application. This is one PhD route, not a separate Operations Management department or award.
limitations: Research-area/subject wording preserved; generic award is PhD via MPhil, subject named Operations Management.
The imported OM List person's 2003 doctorate remains individual discovery only.
